description: Processes global online payments through Stripe's PaymentIntents API. Supports card payments, UPI, net banking, and international payment methods. Preferred for international-facing fintech platforms and SaaS products that need PCI-DSS compliant payment processing across multiple currencies. Includes 3DS2 authentication, Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), and Stripe Radar fraud detection. Used for collecting loan EMIs, processing service fees, and managing subscription-based billing.
use_cases: EMI repayment via saved card mandate
Loan origination fee and processing fee collection
Subscription-based recurring billing for SaaS lending products
Payment link generation for remote payment collection
compliance_context: PCI-DSS Level 1 certified. 3DS2 and SCA compliant for EU and RBI-mandated card authentication. Stripe processes under GDPR for EU customers.
typical_callers: International fintech lenders, SaaS lending platforms, global banks, insurtech platforms collecting premiums in multiple currencies
auth_description: API Key authentication. Stripe Secret Key passed as bearer token in Authorization header.

versions.release_notes: Adaptive Pricing and enhanced Radar rules

required_fields.description: Payment amount in smallest currency unit (paise for INR, cents for USD)
Stripe Customer ID for associating the payment
Whether to confirm and capture the PaymentIntent immediately

optional_fields.description: Key-value pairs for loan or tenant tagging
Email to send Stripe-hosted payment receipt
Save payment method for future EMI mandate charges

next_action.description: 3DS2 redirect or OTP challenge if needed
